deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'i=0; until ./stellar-disbursement-platform db admin migrate up; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -gt 40 ] && exit 1; echo waiting-for-db; sleep 3; done; ./stellar-disbursement-platform db tss migrate up && ./stellar-disbursement-platform db auth migrate up --all && ./stellar-disbursement-platform db sdp migrate up --all && { (while true; do echo starting-tss-worker; ./stellar-disbursement-platform tss; echo tss-exited-restarting; sleep 5; done) & ./stellar-disbursement-platform serve; }'
